app.title: A general purpose Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs
app.description: Stela implements a lightweight emulation layer that allows x86‑64 binaries to run on Apple Silicon with near‑native performance.
proposed_tests: Install Stela and run a small x86‑64 benchmark binary; measure execution time.
Compare runtime of the same binary under native x86‑64 emulation (QEMU) vs Stela.
Validate that a simple C program compiles and runs correctly on Stela.
